# Test fixtures

`sunocaps_sample.csv` is a hand-made test sample (24 tracks = 6 prompts × 4 versions)
assembled from notebook output. Some fields are guesses: `Emotion`, `Instrumental`,
the empty comments and the `-0Gj8-vB1q4` caption.

Use it for unit tests only, never for results. Real numbers always come from
`data/raw/SunoCaps_dataset.csv`.
